claims: All Publix store locations and pharmacies will be closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
Publix closes only for three holidays annually—Easter, Thanksgiving, and Christmas Day.
Publix stores will resume regular business hours on Monday, April 6, 2026.
Publix stores will be open regular hours on Saturday, April 4, 2026.
Publix stores will be open regular hours on Monday, April 6, 2026.
